svg.title: asm-hf-rancher-104x78
svg.desc: Batch 2: Rancher (HSB-RNCH) [4ft, 3-Rail]: 4×6 posts (5.5" wide face), 3× 2×6 cedar face-mounted horizontal boards (50% post overlap), HeadLOK structural timber screws, pyramid caps. Authored strictly to canonical 104×78 inch artboard, Shell Law, and procedural flow grain.
